description: This Java class 'XMLWriter' serializes objects into XML format, handling object references, properties, and collections, primarily for Android navigation components.

classes.name: XMLWriter
classes.description: Main class for serializing objects into XML, managing object references, properties, and XML structure.

classes.name: XMLWriter.Info
classes.description: Holds metadata about objects during serialization, such as assigned IDs and reference counts.

classes.name: XMLWriter.NameValue
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a named value pair, with methods for writing and adding to XML elements.

classes.name: XMLWriter.Attribute
classes.description: Represents an XML attribute with a name and value.

classes.name: XMLWriter.ClassAttribute
classes.description: Specialized attribute for class type information, with custom logic for adding to parent elements.

classes.name: XMLWriter.Element
classes.description: Represents an XML element with tag, type, attributes, and child elements, capable of writing itself to XML.

methods.name: XMLWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the writer with an output stream.

methods.name: isPrimitive
methods.description: Checks if a class type is a primitive or String.

methods.name: nextId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a class type.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of a class, computing if necessary.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes an object into XML format.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Recursively traverses an object, creating XML elements and attributes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Prints a string with indentation and a newline.
